claim: The University of Malta general entry requirement for IB holders is the IB Diploma with at least 28 points and passes at 3 or better in a language, a science and a humanistic subject. HL normally stands for a MATSEC Advanced Level and SL for Intermediate; IB 7 to 3 map to MATSEC grades A to E.
excerpt: International Baccalaureate Diploma with at least 28 points, and with passes at 3 points or better in a language, a science and a humanistic subject. … Higher Level (HL) subjects are normally accepted where a MATSEC Advanced Level is required, while Standard Level (SL) subjects are normally accepted where a MATSEC Intermediate Level is required.
interpretation: The same page lists SEC Level 3 passes in Mathematics, English Language and Maltese and says they 'may also be satisfied through the subjects presented in the IB Diploma if such subjects are deemed comparable'. The admissions FAQs add that a non-Maltese applicant educated abroad may offer another language instead of Maltese with Admissions Board approval. Page last updated 21 April 2026.
